overview: This table sets how much story demos change the relationship between two characters the first time you clear them.
description: Directed relationship-point changes granted by story demos: two character ids and the point delta in each direction.

ID.simple: The unique name for this relationship change, used to connect it to a story demo.
ID.technical: FName native Id (exported as ID; ImportKeyField=Id) and the 143-row table key. DTM resolves the single loader named StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTable into StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTables (+0x890); row finds scan that array in order and return the first matching row. StoryDemo.Id_StoryCharaRelateChange is a 12-slot FName array in the export, padded with 'None'; OnStoryDemoFirstClear, the battle-story icon preload and WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges skip 'None' before FindRow. The same id is matched against the demo list when filtering changes for a pair, and non-None ids are counted in story-completion percentage.

Id_Character_1.simple: The first character whose relationship toward the other character changes in this story demo. The game also shows this character's face icon.
Id_Character_1.technical: FName. Row orientation is authoritative for the save map: first clear adds ChangeValue_1_2 to UserInfo.Story.StudioNestedNameInts_770[Id_Character_1][Id_Character_2] and ChangeValue_2_1 to the reverse entry. Detail-list and new-story filtering accept the exact pair or its reverse; the result aggregator re-orients reversed rows. The battle-story preload resolves both ids to face-icon sprite names in every tracked icon size. All 16 exported character ids also have CharacterDataTable and StoryCharaGraphPair rows.

Id_Character_2.simple: The other character in the pair, whose relationship toward the first character can change. The game also shows this character's face icon.
Id_Character_2.technical: FName. Receives ChangeValue_2_1 in StudioNestedNameInts_770[Id_Character_2][Id_Character_1] and is the partner in pair filtering, aggregate display and face-icon preload. GetCharaRelateLevel and reward/graph consumers look up the graph row by the ordered first id, then use Id_Character.Find(Other) to select StartRelateLevel and Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel; that index is unchecked in code, but every exported pair resolves to a valid index.

ChangeValue_1_2.simple: How much this story demo changes the first character's relationship toward the second. A bigger number can raise the relationship level more.
ChangeValue_1_2.technical: int32, constructor default 0. Units are cumulative relationship points, not levels: STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5 Min thresholds are 0/25/50/75/100 in GlobalThresholdDataTable. On first clear OnStoryDemoFirstClear adds it to the nested save map at [Id_Character_1][Id_Character_2]. WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges sums all demo rows into FGameChangedCharaRelateLevelInfo.Change1; that total is added to the saved value plus StoryRelationValue(GraphPair.StartRelateLevel[partner index]) and converted by WidgetTest_StoryRelationLevel. The result dialog renders the new level and level increase, not the raw point total. Exported values are 5, 10, 12, 13 or 25 (min 5, max 25; 25 in 118 of 143 rows).

ChangeValue_2_1.simple: How much the second character's relationship toward the first changes. Bigger numbers can raise it more, and it can differ from the other direction.
ChangeValue_2_1.technical: int32, constructor default 0; the same first-clear accumulation, GraphPair start-level conversion and aggregate-display path as ChangeValue_1_2 in the opposite direction, stored at [Id_Character_2][Id_Character_1] and summed into Change2. Exported values are 5, 10, 12, 13, 25 or 50; only CP_070_CP_110_01/02/03 are asymmetric (25/12, 25/13 and 25/50), so equal directional deltas cannot be assumed.

notes: Loader and lookup: DTM registers only the exact name StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTable (GameDataTableManager.cpp:440), resolves its one loader into StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTables at +0x890 (GameDataTableManager.cpp:267, GameDataTableManager.h:178), and AddLoadedDataTables skips null assets. FGameDataTableArray::GetRows returns rows in table order then row-name order (GameDataTableArray.h:19-36); named finds return the first matching row. No alias or shard loader name was found.

First-clear accumulation is caller-gated, not internal to OnStoryDemoFirstClear: the demo-only path (GamePhase_StoryDemoPreBattle.cpp:76-84) requires state < 2 and sets state 2 before calling, while the battle path (GamePhase_BattleStory.cpp:403-416) requires winner team 0 and mission Record.Rank < 1 and then sets rank/state. OnStoryDemoFirstClear itself only skips 'None' ids and missing rows; a repeated direct call would add the deltas again. It uses FindOrAdd, so an absent nested int defaults to 0 (GameManagerGraphics.cpp:451-489).

Result display: WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges skips 'None'/missing ids, groups by unordered pair (reversing stored orientation when needed), sums the two directed values, derives previous/new levels from saved points plus GraphPair start level using the five GlobalThreshold Min values, and removes pairs where neither direction gains a level (GamePhase_WidgetTest.cpp:350-406). UGameDialogWidget::OpenRelationshipChanges also no-ops on an empty list (GameDialogWidget.cpp:83-88). The list item prints new levels and level increases, not raw points (GameCharaRelateLevelListItemWidget.cpp:80-92).

Export coverage: one main table with 143 unique rows, ID equal to the row key in every row, no empty ids or zero/negative deltas. The 13 datatables_by_character copies are row subsets with identical values, not additional shards; no numbered or locale variants were found. All 143 ids are referenced exactly once by 115 StoryDemo rows (every Id_StoryCharaRelateChange array has 12 slots padded with 'None'); 77 demos have at least one change, with no missing or unreferenced change ids.

Relationships and indices: the 16 character ids are all present in CharacterDataTable; the 44 unordered pairs all resolve in StoryCharaGraphPair and StoryCharaRelateLevel and have matching StoryCharaRelateReward pairs. Start levels come from GraphPair.StartRelateLevel at Id_Character.Find(Other) (valid for all exported pairs), relation levels from GlobalThreshold, and reward item sets from StoryCharaRelateReward.Id_ItemSet[Level - 1] plus saved StudioNameInts_7C0 (GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:1110-1164). These are separate tables, not fields of this row.

Evidence status: runtime behavior here is traced through the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (RVAs in comments) and the exported data; status/ marks several direct consumers behavioural or match but leaves WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges as todo. No retail Blueprint graphs, uncooked asset internals, retail byte comparison or runtime trace were independently checked; AGENTS.md's statement that Blueprints contain no logic was not re-proven here.

usages.detail: Resolves the exact primary-asset loader name into the cached StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTables array (+0x890); the name is registered at line 440.
The cached table-array helper enumerates typed rows in table then row-name order, the basis for pair-wide filtering.
OnStoryDemoFirstClear walks the demo's change ids, skips None, finds the first matching row and adds both directed deltas to the nested save map.
Demo-only first-clear caller: state < 2 is set to 2 before OnStoryDemoFirstClear is invoked.
Battle first-clear caller: winner team 0 and mission Record.Rank < 1 invoke OnStoryDemoFirstClear, then rank and demo state are updated.
Before battle rules, unresolved demos collect both character ids from each non-None change row and preload their face-icon sprites in every tracked size.
Aggregates demo change rows into directed Change1/Change2 entries, handles reversed row orientation, derives levels, and drops pairs with no level increase.
GetCharaRelateLevel consumes the accumulated save-map points plus the GraphPair start-level threshold to return the current directed level.
Story result step requests the relationship-change dialog only for winner team 0 while demo state is missing or < 2; an empty aggregate is suppressed.
Opens the level-change subdialog for the aggregated entries; no dialog is opened when the list is empty.
Displays each direction's new level and level increase, using GraphPair and StoryCharaRelateLevel rows for the friendly/hostile label.
Filters all change rows by the selected pair in either order, then lists demos whose id array contains one of those change ids (alongside pair-release demos).
Story_IsCharaRelateNew uses the pair's change ids to find unfinished relation demos (state 1) and also checks short-story seen state 2.
Shows both directed levels via GetCharaRelateLevel and the new-content badge via Story_IsCharaRelateNew.
Story_HasNewCharaRelate propagates the pair helper to per-character new-content indicators after release checks.
Reward processing compares GraphPair start levels with GetCharaRelateLevel in both directions and grants StoryCharaRelateReward item sets once.
StoryCharaRelateThreshold unlock progress requires both directed relationship levels to be at least the requested level.
Counts non-None relation-change ids in the story-completion percentage numerator and denominator.
